I'm Hanz. Welcome To The House.

“We celebrate the past. We fuel the present. We build the future of physical media.”

Hanz is more than a mascot. He helps visitors understand MAD HOUSE, find their way around, learn how buying and trading works, and discover new inventory.

For the culture. For the collection.
